text: One token one vote on chain governance produces plutocracy: it allocates more power to holders of a significant share of supply so that majority token holders have more power than all other holders combined, reintroducing the defects of one share one vote legacy designs.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralization Neutralizers (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3808873
abstract: A one- token-one-vote design allocates more power to token holders who have a significant share of the total supply of a given token. Majority token holders have more power than the rest of the token holders combined.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: on chain voting mechanisms of the early 2020s
